div.div: 6 تصافقوا (S, M, O) They struck their hands upon the hands of others (O) عِنْدَ البَيْعَةِ [on the occasion of the ratifying of a sale, or covenant]: (S, O:) or they [struck a bargain;] bought and sold; or made a covenant, or compact; one with another. (M, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
